verdict.rationale: Google Cloud documents a Cloud Billing REST API for managing billing programmatically, and a Budget API that tracks actual spend against planned spend with Pub/Sub-linked cost controls. That gives some programmatic access to cost information, but nothing shows queryable line-item cost data. Missing for 10: documented cost-data query API, scheduled cost exports, resource-level granularity, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an analyst, cost data is queryable — a billing/cost API and scheduled exports with resource-level granularity, not just a dashboard screenshot

citations.quote: Allows developers to manage billing for their Google Cloud Platform projects programmatically.
A budget enables you to track your actual Google Cloud spend against your planned spend.
